name: Jellyio Streams
description: Stream Stremio-addon content from your self-hosted AIOStreams instance. The plugin generates a Jellyfin library (.strm files plus nfo metadata) with a Stremio-like stream picker: each resolved stream becomes a selectable version of the item. Includes catalog sync, search & add, and a scheduled refresh task.
overview: Stream Stremio-addon content from a self-hosted AIOStreams instance

versions.changelog: API endpoints return proper 400 responses with readable messages instead of unhandled 500s; config page now shows HTTP status and server error text instead of '[object Response]'.

Harden config page: errors now display on the page instead of failing silently; Save builds the config from the form directly (works even if initial load failed); defensive ApiClient/Dashboard checks; global error hook.

Fix: configuration page rewritten in plain HTML. Jellyfin 10.11 no longer processes emby components (data-require) and never fires DOMContentLoaded on injected plugin pages, so the previous page showed raw icon text ('saveSave') and its buttons did nothing.
Fix: scheduled task trigger now correctly uses IntervalTrigger type. Fixes a startup crash ('Info did not contain a TimeOfDayTicks') that prevented Jellyfin from starting when the plugin was enabled.
Initial release: catalog sync, search & add, version-based stream selection, scheduled refresh.
